notes.subject: בטחתי
notes.rationale: Hibru 'mi ran i go long stretpela ples bilong hod yu' — mi tanim olsem 'mi strongpela bel long'.

notes.subject: חרפי
notes.rationale: Hibru 'ol birua bilong mi' — 'man i tok nogut long mi' — preposition mini bilong Hibru i mini 'ol i tokim mi olsem'. Klauset: 'rausim ol gutpela nem bilong mi'.

translation: Na bai mi gat tok bilong bekim man i tok nogut long mi, long wanem mi strongpela bel long tok bilong yu.

tokens.gloss: man i tok nogut long mi
